title: Glowing helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff9f1c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7ce7ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2b9fd8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- rotor blur -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='44' ry='4' fill='#8ee8ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='8' y='19' width='84' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#bff6ff'/>

  <!-- rotor mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='22' width='6' height='9' rx='2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='21' r='4' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <!-- tail boom -->
  <path d='M62 46 L92 40 L92 46 L64 52 Z' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='43' r='7' fill='#8ee8ff' opacity='0.55'/>
  <rect x='91' y='35' width='2' height='16' rx='1' fill='#c8f6ff'/>
  <rect x='84' y='42' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c8f6ff'/>

  <!-- main body -->
  <path d='M18 56 Q16 44 32 42 L58 42 Q70 42 72 52 Q73 60 62 62 L26 62 Q18 62 18 56 Z' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- belly shade -->
  <path d='M22 60 Q26 62 36 62 L60 62 Q56 58 50 57 L26 57 Z' fill='#f08c00' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- canopy -->
  <path d='M22 52 Q20 44 32 43 Q44 43 46 50 Q46 56 34 57 Q24 57 22 52 Z' fill='url(#glass)'/>
  <path d='M26 47 Q30 44 36 45 Q40 46 41 49 Q36 50 30 50 Q27 50 26 47 Z' fill='#e6fbff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- side window -->
  <path d='M52 45 Q60 45 62 50 Q62 55 54 55 Q50 55 50 50 Q50 45 52 45 Z' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <path d='M54 47 Q58 47 59 50 Q56 51 53 51 Q52 49 54 47 Z' fill='#c9f4ff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x='24' y='72' width='42' height='3.5' rx='1.7' fill='#6b8fd8'/>
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='3' height='11' rx='1.4' fill='#5a7cc4'/>
  <rect x='56' y='62' width='3' height='11' rx='1.4' fill='#5a7cc4'/>

  <!-- stripe -->
  <rect x='40' y='56' width='28' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff5d73'/>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M88 40 L92 32 L95 33 L93 40 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <!-- glow dots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='66' r='2' fill='#fff3a8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='2' fill='#fff3a8'/>
</svg>
